parent_objective: design a no-training unsafe-margin projection probe along the M1147 direction
blocked_by: M1151 closes direct actor-update continuation and opens row15_promoted_unsafe_margin_projection
invalidates: generic actor update without wrong-history unsafe-margin screen

public_gates: M1152 must not train actor weights
M1152 must not mine new rows
M1152 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken M1149 first-replay thresholds
do not accept an alpha that makes any M1149 failed wrong-history row safe

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M1151 synthesis into a bounded no-training projection design using exact objective and failed-row unsafe-margin screens
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot combine exact M1144 improvement with wrong-history unsafe-margin retention
stop if it requires privileged actor inputs
stop if it would bypass first replay before further escalation
fallback_plan: if no nonzero interpolation alpha can satisfy unsafe-margin retention, route to terminal-margin objective design
if an alpha passes failed-row unsafe screens but first replay fails, route to row-level audit
if first replay passes, design family/behavior checks rather than promotion

training_stage.stage_objective: design a no-training interpolation/projection probe before any new actor update
admission_evidence: M1147 full actor update improves exact M1144 objective but fails first replay
M1150 shows the materialized failures are objective-covered near-boundary rows
M1151 opens the unsafe-margin projection branch
blocked_shortcuts: do not run replay in this design milestone
allowed_updates: next run manifest if design is clear
status, queue, scoreboard, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: exact M1144 objective acceptance rule is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1152 designs a proof-retention repair and cannot upgrade to anticipatory self-identification.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1152 adds no new temporal task and only designs a repair using existing proof rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no nonzero projection alpha satisfies unsafe-margin retention, record that projection is insufficient and route to a new terminal-margin objective.
allowed_claims: no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: A no-training interpolation along the M1147 exact-objective direction may admit a small nonzero alpha that improves exact M1144 objective while preserving wrong-history unsafe terminal margins on the M1149 failed rows.
success_criteria: unsafe-margin sign rule requires every M1149 failed wrong-history row to remain unsuccessful with terminal margin below zero
normal-success retention requires every M1149 failed normal-history row to remain successful
exact M1144 objective acceptance requires non-regression and prefers improvement
M1153 run scope is limited to no-training interpolation/projection plus first replay only
no actor training, PPO, replay, mining, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: run scope admits PPO, actor training, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1152 may only design a no-training unsafe-margin projection probe. It cannot train actor weights, run PPO, run replay, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, weaken M1149 thresholds, or accept any alpha that makes a failed wrong-history row safe.
